body:
15mg 2C-I, 10mg mdpv,  300mg trazadone & 1 tiny bowl of Spice Max herbal incense are consumed.
Smoked the MDPV first & got effects in 3-5 minutes. Much like Ritalin. Abundant energy, sharp clarity of thoughts, and the urge to move around.
Next snorted the 2C-I... Burned like hell for 10-15 minutes. Effects took about 2 hours to kick in. The MDPV was wearing off just before the onset of the 2C-I.
2C-I produced pleasurable body load. Everything appeared the glow, colors were brighter/neon like. Mind was stoned but clear & slow. Felt major stimulation much like a  60-100mg of Ritalin. CEV's of vivid fractals churning & twisting. Enjoyable psychedelic but very much milder than LSD or mushrooms.
I smoked 3 hits of Spike Max (jwh-018). Brought to a stoned & dreamy neon land. Felt the need to take the edge off the
Stimulation so I took 3 100mg of Trazodone. 45  minutes later all the effects experienced were heightened yet much more relaxed & comfortable. The experience lasted roughly 8 hours with a peak of 3-4 hours.
Summary: Fun, easy going, & worthwhile experience. I will do this again sometime soon.
